instruction: Buy me the cheapest face shield on amazon that will reach my home within 4 days. My payment cards do not have any money. So please transfer the minimum required money for the order from venmo to a card first.
notes: Two-app task (amazon + venmo). The agent must find the cheapest face shield with delivery_days <= 4 (search results carry price and delivery_days; the selection rule is in the binding), add exactly that product to a cleared cart (clear_cart_first=true so the order holds a single item of quantity 1), read the cart total, then transfer that exact amount from the Venmo balance to a payment card and place the order with the same card to the home address. Amazon and Venmo use different ids for the same physical card, so they are modeled as two linked objects (same-card) whose ids are learned via the respective show_payment_cards calls; withdrawing funds marks the amazon-side card as funded, which place_order requires. Apps are domain constants (not redeclared as problem objects). token-of/username-for are static facts that keep logins deterministic. Gmail/file_system record changes in the evaluation are side effects of placing the order and need no API calls. supervisor-complete-task carries the task records (product, address, amount, card) only to enforce the goal conjunction; it passes no answer.
